Goldman Sachs operates a private data center at 755 US 202 in Bridgewater Township, New Jersey. No power capacity, floor space, or technical specifications are published for this facility. The company does not disclose these figures on its corporate site or in public sources searched.

New Jersey has 48 mapped data center facilities of which five publish power capacity totaling 111.3 MW. This campus does not contribute a published figure to that total. Without disclosed specifications, its position in state rankings cannot be determined from capacity alone.

This facility is not a marketed colocation or cloud service. As a proprietary internal data center, it may serve Goldman Sachs' own compute needs rather than external customers. The absence of published detail makes it invisible to capacity tracking used to assess AI infrastructure scaling.
